Cleaning our homes is never going to make anyone’s list of favorite activities, but with the right technology, the task can be made almost effortless.

Whether you’re looking for an affordable robot vacuum for a small apartment or the ultimate flagship model capable of coping with the challenges of a large home, pet hair, and more, there’s a Roborock model for you – and with Black Friday savings of up to $1,650, there’s never been a better time to buy.

Saros 20

Roborock’s 2026 flagship model offers the ultimate in truly intelligent cleaning thanks to a combination of raw cleaning power and a market-leading combination of smart features.

The benefits begin with a combination of raw power, reach, and fully automated self-cleaning. The Saros 20 delivers 36,000 Pa suction power with a dual anti-tangle system, ensuring no hassle with even the toughest of pet hairs, while a FlexiArm system ensures true edge-to-edge cleaning. The fully automated dock takes care of emptying the dust as well as washing and drying the mops.

AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0 enables the Saros 20 to move freely around the most largest and most complex of homes. A combination of an advanced vision system, adaptive algorithms, and a mechanical system comprising a main wheel, auxiliary wheel, and climbing arm mean that the device can cope with most thresholds between rooms. This even includes double layer thresholds, totaling 3.46 inches.

The Saros 20 uses StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, an industry-first navigation system with true 3D mapping of your home. The setup combines LiDAR with time-of-flight measurements to create an accurate depth map with both visual and infrared camera systems. The specs are unrivaled, with a sampling frequency more than 20 times higher than other devices and 21,600 sensor points, but what counts are the results. The AI powered system can recognize more than 300+ types of obstacles, even when they are are less than an inch in width and height. That means it can avoid anything from a loose cable to an inquisitive pet.

AdaptiLift technology combines with a Carpet Intelligence System to enables the Saros 20 to detect when it is moving from solid flooring to carpet. At the most basic level, this means the mops will never get your carpets wet, but the system is far more sophisticated than this. The robot will automatically lift itself up onto deep pile carpets before lowering to the optimal height for vacuuming. It can cope with carpets with a pile height of 1.18 inches.

Finally, Smart Plan 3.0 is the AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyzes your home’s unique layout, floor materials, and the behavior patterns of everyone in the home in order to automatically optimise its cleaning routines. You also get voice and app control and can even check on your pets while away by asking the Saros 20 to locate them and provide a live video feed.

Qrevo Edge 3 Pro

The Qrevo Edge 3 Pro aims to provide a balance between advanced features and everyday practicality. Its focus is on meeting the needs of those with the most complex home environments. If you’ve ever found you need to frequently rescue a robot cleaner, this is the model for you. It can recognize and avoid more than 300 types of objects and obstacles, and has a low clearance height of less than 3.2 inches enabling it to pass beneath most furniture.

It offers the same combination of raw power, reach, and fully automated self-cleaning as the Saros 20, with 36,000 Pa suction power with a dual anti-tangle system for the toughest of pet hairs. The Qrevo Edge 3 Pro offers enhanced mopping performance, applying up to 14 Newtons of downward pressure. Extended battery life means it can clean more than 3,700 square feet in a single run. Again, the fully automated dock takes care of emptying the dust as well as washing the mops.

Qrevo S Pro

The Qrevo S Pro is premium cleaning power made affordable. It combines powerful suction, automatic dust emptying, mop washing and drying, and water refilling to make everyday cleaning effortless.

Its 18,500 Pa suction force is strong enough for everyday pickup of crumbs, hair, and dust, with high temperature mop cleaning. You get dual spinning mops with up to 30 levels of water flow and automatic lifting when it reaches carpets. An anti-tangle side brush copes with most pet hairs.

F25 Steam

If you prefer a more hands-on approach to cleaning, the F25 Steam is Roborock’s flagship model. It’s designed for busy households with pets, combining deep cleaning power with advanced hair and stain handling to reduce manual effort on high traffic, heavily soiled areas.

It offers a powerful 25,000 Pa suction power, with 356F VaporFlow steam cleaning. Using steam rather than water means that the F25 Steam effectively removes bacteria and allergens while being gentle on wooden floors. The dual-edge roller design allows the unit to reach right into edges and corners for more thorough cleaning.

F25 XT

Finally, the F25 XT offers quick and effortless cleanup of wet and dry mess when either kids or pets have little accidents.

It combines 20,000 Pa suction with a smart dirt detection system. This automatically adjusts the suction and amount of solution dispensed based on the dirt levels. An effortless dual scraper system uses a combination of flat water-control blade & comb scraper for streak-free zero-tangle floors. Finally, the F25 XT includes high temperature self-cleaning and rapid drying.
